description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for generating various leave reports within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It maps report names to report classes and provides a method to retrieve the appropriate report based on request parameters.

classes.name: LeaveReportAPI
classes.description: A PHP class extending ReportAPI, providing an API for generating specific leave reports based on report name parameters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate report class instance based on the 'name' parameter in the request. Throws a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
